rules.check: Identify the intended user task and compare the visual emphasis of competing actions.
rules.evidence: Capture the initial viewport and annotate the primary action and competing elements.
rules.remediation: Reduce competing emphasis while retaining necessary secondary actions.

rules.check: Compare the proposed typography, imagery and composition with confirmed brand and audience constraints.
rules.evidence: Record the brief, asset provenance and a rendered example.
rules.remediation: Prefer established brand choices; document any deliberate deviation rather than replacing the whole style.

rules.check: Check whether numerical claims, quotes, logos and illustrative assets have supplied provenance.
rules.evidence: List each claim and its supplied source, or mark it as unverified.
rules.remediation: Remove invented proof or visibly label placeholder content; do not manufacture replacements.

rules.check: Review repetitive card nesting and decorative treatments for a useful relationship to the product.
rules.evidence: Annotate repeated patterns in a screenshot and explain the distraction or benefit.
rules.remediation: Simplify only patterns that obscure the user task; retain justified brand choices.

rules.check: Inspect apparent alignment of icons, labels and neighboring controls at actual display size.
rules.evidence: Capture the affected controls at their target scale, including adjacent elements.
rules.remediation: Adjust local spacing or icon placement without changing hit areas or layout semantics.

rules.check: Inspect headings and compact labels with long localized text and narrow containers.
rules.evidence: Record screenshots of normal and long text at narrow and wide widths.
rules.remediation: Choose wrapping or truncation deliberately; preserve access to the complete meaning.

rules.check: Compare icon family, weight and state treatment across one interface surface.
rules.evidence: List icon sources and show default, active and disabled examples.
rules.remediation: Reuse the installed family and consistent visual weight; retain accessible names.

rules.check: Traverse the complete scoped flow with the keyboard and inspect focus visibility and order.
rules.evidence: Record keyboard steps, focused selectors, viewport and screenshots; include overlays.
rules.remediation: Restore visible focus and logical navigation without suppressing outline globally.

rules.check: Exercise animated state changes with reduced motion enabled and disabled.
rules.evidence: Record media preference, interaction steps and whether state changes remain understandable.
rules.remediation: Provide a restrained alternative that preserves necessary feedback and does not hide content.

rules.check: Inspect computed accessible names and roles for controls, including icon-only buttons.
rules.evidence: Record role/name output and the affected selector in each relevant state.
rules.remediation: Use meaningful visible labels or explicit accessible names; do not guess action semantics.

rules.check: Measure controls and spacing against the project touch-target policy and verify neighboring hit regions.
rules.evidence: Record CSS-pixel bounds, spacing, device context and the policy being evaluated.
rules.remediation: Enlarge or space hit regions without overlapping adjacent controls. Do not equate a preferred 44px target with universal conformance.

rules.check: Submit invalid and corrected input and inspect label association, error announcement and retained values.
rules.evidence: Record steps, accessible descriptions and focus after failure and recovery.
rules.remediation: Connect errors to inputs, keep entered data and provide a discoverable recovery path.

rules.check: Inspect page and component overflow at scoped viewports, text zoom and long-content states.
rules.evidence: Record viewport, zoom, scroll widths and affected elements; distinguish intentional scrolling.
rules.remediation: Fix the constrained element or wrapping; do not hide page overflow to mask inaccessible content.

rules.check: Review foreground and background token pairings across each supported theme.
rules.evidence: Record resolved color pairs, theme names and any intentional fixed-color assets.
rules.remediation: Use semantic surface/content pairs where appropriate, then measure actual rendered contrast.

rules.check: Measure text and interactive-state contrast in supported themes using the applicable project standard.
rules.evidence: Record measured colors, ratios, text size/weight, theme and applicable criterion.
rules.remediation: Adjust a shared token where feasible and recheck every affected theme and state.

rules.check: Compare component classes and required structure against the installed daisyUI version, configuration and prefix.
rules.evidence: Record package version, selected component reference and source location.
rules.remediation: Use documented class composition for that version; do not introduce daisyUI into unrelated stacks.

rules.check: Switch configured themes and inspect nested theme boundaries and foreground inheritance.
rules.evidence: Record theme configuration, nested selectors and screenshots in each supported theme.
rules.remediation: Correct scope or semantic tokens without forcing unrelated components into a global theme.

rules.check: Rapidly repeat, reverse and cancel animated interactions and inspect the final state.
rules.evidence: Record the repeated input sequence and final visual and semantic control states.
rules.remediation: Make transitions interruptible and ensure cancellation clears transient state.

rules.check: Review broad transitions, layout-changing animation and persistent optimization hints for a measured need.
rules.evidence: Record source declarations and, where available, a trace showing actual frame or layout cost.
rules.remediation: Narrow animated properties and remove unsupported optimization hints; profile before claiming a speedup.

rules.check: Observe initial loading and late asset arrival under the explicitly chosen test conditions.
rules.evidence: Record browser, cache state, network/CPU settings, asset timing and layout-shift observations.
rules.remediation: Reserve asset space and optimize the measured bottleneck; avoid lazy-loading the critical initial image blindly.

rules.check: Check whether chart encoding fits the comparison task and remains understandable without color alone.
rules.evidence: Record the analytical question, chart data, legend and nonvisual alternative.
rules.remediation: Choose an encoding matching the data relationship and preserve labels or a table alternative.

rules.check: Compare interaction conventions with the detected platform and actual input devices.
rules.evidence: Record platform, framework, inputs and a representative task walkthrough.
rules.remediation: Apply platform-appropriate conventions instead of transplanting native-only behavior to web.

rules.check: Review empty, pending, failure and successful states for a clear next action.
rules.evidence: Capture each state with its trigger and intended recovery behavior.
rules.remediation: Add truthful feedback and actionable recovery while preserving user input and business rules.

rules.check: Review actual rendered output separately from source-code correctness and task completion.
rules.evidence: Record screenshot paths, viewport, reviewer and unresolved visual observations.
rules.remediation: Resolve justified findings and repeat the affected render; never claim visual review from code alone.
